$ labctl users list
No users defined. Add one with: labctl users add <name> --role operator

$ labctl users add olive --role operator --password s3cret-pass
User "olive" added (role: operator)

$ labctl users add pat --role participant
Password: User "pat" added (role: participant)

$ labctl users list
NAME    ROLE
olive   operator
pat     participant

$ labctl users add pat --role operator --password another-pass
User "pat" updated (role: operator)

$ labctl users remove olive
User "olive" removed

$ labctl users list
NAME   ROLE
pat    operator
